roles.title: Director-General
roles.organisation: International Labour Office of the International Labour Organization

details.summary: American attorney for the National Labor Relations Board and fifth Director-General of the International Labour Office of the International Labour Organization (ILO) 1948-1970
details.life: Was born 31 May 1907 in New York City, United States, and passed away 1 December 1990 in New York City. He was the son of Morris Moscovitz, cabinetmaker, and Sara Werblin. On 13 May 1937 he married Mildred Edna Hockstader. They had no children.
details.editors: Bob Reinalda, Kent J. Kille and Jaci L. Eisenberg
